column1: # GENERATED, do not edit by hand:
# Mechanically extracted from a bpf-next checkout by
# INCLUSION RULE (the reviewable judgement; see SINGLE_FAMILY_ARG_TYPES in
# helper_proto.rs): an arg becomes a contract ONLY when its arg_type pins it to
# exactly ONE verifier reg-type family. ARG_ANYTHING, ARG_PTR_TO_MEM variants,
# map key/value pointers and BTF/sock/timer pointers are DROPPED — asserting a
# single family there would manufacture false positives. Dropped means the diff
# stage cannot corroborate and stays silent, which is not "no violation".
